finalVerification.excerpt: Vent temp 41F at idle, 45 min run test, no further concern.

complaintVerification.excerpt: Confirmed humming noise from left front between 45 and 70 mph, louder when turning right (loading left side).

diagnosticApproach.excerpt: Road tested vehicle 6 miles, raised vehicle and used chassis ears; noise loudest at left front hub. Spun wheel by hand, felt roughness in left front hub bearing. Measured axial play 0.008 in, spec 0.002 in max.

failureMode.excerpt: left front hub bearing internal failure

repairAction.excerpt: Removed and replaced left front hub bearing assembly. Torqued axle nut and hub bolts to spec.

finalVerification.excerpt: Road tested 6 miles, mileage in 41,218, mileage out 41,224, no humming noise at any speed or while turning.

Specify what was wrong with the regulator (e.g., stuck, damaged).
Include post-repair verification method: 'Tested window operation after replacement, confirmed proper functioning.'

complaintVerification.excerpt: Verified customer concern of harsh shift

diagnosticApproach.excerpt: Connected scan tool and retrieved code P0756 shift solenoid B performance. Checked transmission fluid level and condition, fluid level was correct and fluid condition was normal for mileage. Performed pinpoint tests per service information.

failureMode.excerpt: determined that the shift solenoid B is faulty

repairAction.excerpt: Removed valve body and replaced shift solenoid B. Reinstalled valve body and refilled fluid to proper level.

finalVerification.excerpt: Road tested vehicle, shifts are now normal. Verified proper operation.
